title: Orchestration viewer
description: Read-only DAG viewer: FlowGraph, sibling watch, declared canvasCommand. Status lives outside Pier.
antiPatterns: calling run.spawn or run.stop from pier/host
interpolating shell strings at runtime; declare them in instance.json
building a task ledger, scheduler, or edit-topology UI on the canvas
inventing methodology tabs for a viewer
agentPrompt: Freeform composition. This canvas is a viewer: status ownership stays in the external system. Root in WorldStage. Render with FlowGraph presentation="plain" (status coloring, meta/badge, edge labels; persist positions via useCanvasFile state/positions.json). Use renderOverlay for gates and onSelectNode plus a Stack beside the graph for details. Relayout with layoutFlowGraph or empty positions. Declare commands in instance.json and call file.invokeCommand(key) — never run.spawn. After started, pull run.output on that runId and subscribe pier://tasks:runs-changed. Poll only http://127.0.0.1 or http://localhost. Rewrite every user-visible string into the user's language. See templates/dag-viewer.canvas.tsx.
